purpose: Offline research readiness ledger. It does not authorize hardware booting or flashing.

unresolved_blockers.detail: 0x5FC41000..0x5FF00000 is inherited from Seluna/Luna. No fixed DT overlap is observed, but pre-Linux bootloader/TrustZone ownership is not proven.
ImageResources/bootstrap.bin is exactly the upstream Seluna asset and is not the uploaded CP2A stock kernel; Aurora compatibility is unverified.
No fresh live CP2A fingerprint/slot observation is available after downgrade because normal setup/ADB is unavailable.
Experimental image is not stock-AVB authenticated; actual temporary-boot acceptance/policy has not been established offline.
A current, verified recovery/backup path has not been recorded in project evidence.
